notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! This is the biggest update since ThoxWarRoom began, and I'm really excited to share it. Your chats now live on your phone first, and you can use ThoxWarRoom entirely without a server.

bullets.text: Hermes Agent: connect your server, watch its tools work, approve sensitive steps, and schedule agents for later.
Direct connections: chat with OpenAI-compatible services or Ollama, including OpenRouter, LM Studio, and Ollama Cloud.
Thoughtful details: smoother chats and calmer navigation. Thank you for being here!

notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: ThoxWarRoom v4.1 — major feature expansion with desktop support, AI memories, automations, spotlight, and more.

bullets.text: AI Memories — view, add, edit, and delete AI memories that persist across conversations.
Composer Shortcuts — type @ to switch model, / for prompts, $ for skills, # for knowledge bases.
Automations — schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times with cron expressions.
Model Favorites & Recents — star models for quick access and auto-track recently used.
Usage Insights — dashboard with prompt/token counts, daily activity chart, and model usage breakdown.
Workspace File Browser — explore your Hermes server's file system with search and syntax-highlighted viewer.
Context Compaction — long conversations automatically summarized to stay fast and responsive.
Spotlight — floating chat bar summoned with Shift+Cmd+I (macOS) or Shift+Ctrl+I (Windows).
Desktop Support — native macOS and Windows builds with adaptive window sizing and keyboard shortcuts.
War Room Dashboard — THOX fleet, MeshStack, and ThoxRoute monitoring tabs.
